content: “Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, ta aawatoo, taani ha77i hinttenttoo odiyaa yewuwaa sisite!”
Phawuloosi unttunttoo Ibraayisxxe qaalaan haasayiyaawaa sisiide, kaseppe loythi co77u giina I hawaadan yaageedda.

“Taani Kilqqiyaan de7iyaa Xersseesen yelettaade, ha katamaan Gamaaliyaali taana tamaarissina diccaade, nu aawatuwa higgiyaakka minissa tamaaraade, hachche hintte ubbay haniyaawaadankka, taani Xoossaa yewuwaassi seelettiyaa Ayihuda asa.
Taani macca asaanne attuma asaa oyqqa oyqqaade qasho gollen yeggeedda asaanne, ha ogiyaa kaalliyaa asaa wodhissana gakkanaassi metootheedda asa.

Hawaadankka, qassi, qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuunne cimaa ubbaa shiiquu tawaa markkattanaw danddayee; taani Damasqqon de7iyaa unttunttu ishatuwaa Ayihudatuwaassi, unttunttuppe dabidaabbiyaa akkaade, hewaan de7iyaa asatuu qashettiide murettanaadan, Yeerusalaame unttuntta ahanaw yaa baaddi.
Phawuloosi Kiristtoosakko Simmeedda Bare Simaabaa Odeedda
“Taani baade Damasqqo mateedda wode, seeta gallassaa gidishshin, qoppennaan saluwaappe wolqqaama poo7uu ta matan yuuyyi aadhdhiide poo7eedda.
Taani sa7aan kundda uttaade, ‘Saa7oolaa, Saa7oolaa, taana ayaw yederssay?’ giyaa qaalaa sisaaddi.
“Taani zaaraade, ‘Ta Godaw, neeni oonee?’ yaagaaddi. “Hewaappe guyye, ‘Taani neeni yederssiyaa Naazireetiyaa Yesuusa’ yaageedda.
Taananna ittippe de7iyaawanttu poo7uwaa be7iide yayyeeddino; shin taw haasayiyaawaa qaalaa sisibeykkino.
“ ‘Ta Godaw, taani ayaa udoo?’ yaagaaddi. “Goday taana, ‘Denddaade Damasqqo ba. Neeni oothanaw Xoossay qoppeedda ubbabay new yaani odettanawaa’ yaageedda.
He wolqqaama poo7uwaa diraw, ta ayfii qooqina, taananna de7iyaa asatuu ta kushiyaa oyqqiide, taana goochchina, Damasqqo gakkaaddi.
“Damasqqon de7iyaa Ayihuda ubbay loythi bonchchiya itti Hanaaniyaa giyaa bitani, nu higgiyaassi azazettiide, Xoossaw imetteedda asa.
Hanaanii taakko yiide, ta matan eqqiide taana, ‘Ta ishaw Saa7oolaa, xeella’ yaageedda. Taani he wode he man77iyankka aakko xeellaa aggaaddi.
“I taana hawaadan yaageedda; ‘Nu aawatuwa Xoossay neeni A qofaa eranaw, A xillo Na7aa be7anawunne A doonaappekka haasayaa sisanaw neena kasenna dooreedda.
Ayissi gooppe, neeni be7eeddabaanne siseeddabaa asaa ubbaa sinthan aw markkattanaassa.
Ha77ikka ayaw gami77ay? Denddaade xammaqetta; A sunthaa xeesaadde, ne nagaraappekka meecetta’ yaageedda.
“Taani guyye Yeerusalaame simmaade Geeshsha Golliyan woossishshin, ta ayyaanaan gidaaddi.
Goday taana, ‘Elleellaade, Yeerusalaame kesa ayaw gooppe, neeni taw hawaan markkattiyaawaa asay akkenna’ yaagishshin taani A be7aaddi.
“Taani, ‘Ta Godaw, Ayihuda woosa golliyaa ubbaan neena ammaniyaawantta oyqqaade wadhdheeddawaanne qasho golliyaan yeggeeddawaa unttunttu eriino.
Unttunttu ne markkaa Isxxifaanoosa wodhiyaa wode, taani he yewuwaa eeno gaaddi. Qassi unttunttu miyyiyaan eqqaade, A wodhiyaawanttu mayuwaa naagay’ yaageedda.
“Goday taana, ‘Taani neena Ayihuda gidenna asaakko haakosaa kiittiyaa diraw ba’ geedda” yaageedda.
Phawuloosi Roome Asa Gidiyaawaa Qonccisseedda
Phawuloosi he qaalaa haasayana gakkanaw asay I giyaawaa sisee; hewaappe guyyiyan, barenttu kooshshaa dhoqqu oothiide, “Hawaa gadiyaappe dhayissa; I de7anaw bessenna” yaageeddino.

Unttunttu waassishshin, barenttu mayuwaa bollaw olishshiininne baanaa carkkuwan laalishshin, olaa kaappuu wottaaddaratuu Phawuloosa barenttu de7iyaasaa afana mala azazeedda. Qassi asay ayissi hewaadan aabolla waasseeddinontto eranaw, Phawuloosa lissuwan shocana mala, unttuntta azazeedda.
Shin wottaaddaratuu Phawuloosa dafuwan minissi qachcheedda wode, Phawuloosi bare matan eqqeedda xeetatuwaa kaappuwaa, “Roome gadiyaa asaa pirdday baynnaan shociyaawe hinttenttoo wogee?” yaageedda.
Hewaa xeetatuwaa kaappuu siseedda wode, olaa kaappuwaakko biide, “Ha bitani Roome asa. Neeni ayaa oothana qoppay?” yaagiide oochcheedda.
Olaa kaappuu Phawuloosakko shiiqiide, “Neeni Roome asee? Taw oda” yaageedda. Phawuloosi, “E” yaageedda.
Olaa kaappuu Phawuloosaw zaariide, “Taani ha zaretethaa daro miishshaan shammaaddi” yaageedda. Shin Phawuloosi, “Taani he zerethaappe yelettaaddi” yaageedda.

Hewaa diraw, Phawuloosa biddanaw qooppeeddawanttu man77iyan aappe shaaketti aggeeddino. Olaa kaappuukka Phawuloosi Roome asa gideeddawaa ereedda wode yayyeedda; ayissi gooppe, santhalataan A qashissi wotheedda.
Phawuloosi Ayihudatuwaa Shanggatuwaakko Shiiqeedda

Wonttetha gallassi olaa kaappuu, Ayihudatuu Phawuloosa ayissi mooteeddinonttonne geeshshiide eranaw koyyiide, Phawuloosa billeedda. Yaatiide qeesatuwaa kaappatuunne asay ubbay shiiqana mala azazeedda; qassi Phawuloosa duge wothiide, unttunttu sinthan esseedda.
